sentences.text: It is submitted that the order dated 25.12.2013, passed in connection of   F o o d S a f e t y & S t a n d a r d C a s e N o . 2 8 o f 2 0 1 3 1 4 i s a p p e l l a b l e  before a Tribunal constituted under Section 70 of the Food Safety & Standard  Act, 2006.
My attention has been drawn towards Annexure4 page 18 to show  that till the date appellate tribunal has not been constituted and the appeal filed
It is submitted that the order, which has not attained  its finality, has been directed to be executed by filing Certificate Case No.17 of 2013 14.
In the circumstances prevailing, further proceeding in Certificate Case No.17 of 2013 14 is liable to be set aside.

L e a r n e d c o u n s e l a p p e a r i n g f o r t h e S t a t e i s n o t i n p o s i t i o n t o s u b m i t  whether Tribunal under Section 70 of the Food Safety & Standard Act, 2006 has  been constituted or not.

In the facts and circumstances as submitted above, proceeding of Certificate Case No.17 of 2013 1 4 , a r i s i n g o u t o f F o o d S a f e t y & S t a n d a r d C a s e N o . 2 8 o f 2 0 1 3  1 4 , p e n d i n g i n t h e C o u r t o f S m t . N i r a j K u m a r i , C e r t i f i c a t e O f f i c e r , 
Ranchi shall remain stayed till further order.
I.A. No.4810 of 2014 stands disposed of.
